pay.noBank: No bank details set by staff yet.
pay.confirmStaffCommissionSub: This changes their commission type for future closed days.
pay.name: Name
pay.confirmCreateCommissionSub: Staff can be assigned to it afterward from the staff pay page.
pay.confirmSaveCommissionSub: This affects commissions for every staff member assigned to it going forward.
pay.autoNeedsHours: Auto claims need a minimum hours threshold.
pay.confirmCreateClaimSub: Staff will need to be marked eligible before they can submit against it.
pay.confirmSaveClaimSub: This updates the claim type and any eligibility changes made below.

cadenceSub.weekly: 1 week per period · paid every Monday
cadenceSub.bi_weekly: 2 weeks per period · 26 payouts a year
cadenceSub.four_weekly: 4 weeks per period · 13 payouts a year

pay.scheduleNote: Applies to every staff member. Payouts already marked paid are never changed.
pay.notTheDay: Not the day to change this
pay.notTheDaySub: {n} payout(s) have already been counted into this period, and it still has {days} day(s) to run. Changing now rewrites the window that pay was counted into. Wait until its last day, pay everyone, let the last store close, then switch.
pay.switchClean: Nothing has been counted into the current period yet, so this is a clean handover.
pay.switchLastDay: Today is the last day of the current period, so this is a clean handover — as long as everyone has been paid and every store has closed.
pay.switchCounted: The current period does not end for {days} more day(s), and {n} payout(s) have already been counted into it. Switching now rewrites the window that pay was counted into.
pay.switchOverlap: Note: that period starts before the current one ends, so it covers days the current period already counted.
